description: Phase D entry, subtask 8 -- end-to-end gate that the Director-Renderer bus loop carries the per-tick state-snapshot correctly. Loads the gradient PNG seq (same fixture integration_png_sequence_seek uses), seeks to frame 0, captures the compose target hash. Every tick exercises buildRenderFrame -> serialize -> InMemoryMessageTransport -> deserialize -> PlaybackPresenter, so any drift in the wire format / message body / presenter consumption fails this test. The hash matches png_sequence_seek/frame_0.hash since no math changed -- subtask 8 is a boundary refactor.
